observation: The page is a single long scrolling document 1440px wide and 4883px tall.
evidence: facts.layout page_width 1440, page_height 4883

observation: Content sits in a centered container about 1040px wide, starting at x=200 and ending around x=1240.
evidence: The logo rect is at x=200 and the map image at x=200; the card grid and nav end near x=1240 in slice 0

observation: The body background is a warm off-white rather than pure white.
Full-width bands alternate between the off-white base and a pale mint tint.
evidence: rgb(230,244,236) appears 3 times in top_backgrounds; mint bands are visible behind the map, Total Site Numbers and She:kon sections

observation: A single saturated green is the accent color for buttons, the active filter chip and the green part of the H1.

observation: A darker green is used for link and word text, and it is the second most common text color.

observation: Body and heading text use a dark desaturated indigo-gray instead of black.

observation: A muted gray-violet is used for secondary text such as the card glosses and subtitles.
evidence: rgb(108,107,125) is used 71 times

observation: The page pairs two typefaces: Georgia, a serif, and system-ui, a sans-serif.

observation: The H1 is 56px, bold and centered, and its last words are colored in the green accent.

observation: H2 section headings are 36px bold and set in a tight, slightly condensed sans.

observation: Body text is 17px with a line-height of 27.2px, a ratio of 1.6.
